IPTV Suite synthetic test-data notice

The M2 fixture generator and M4 secret-store spike create their records entirely from deterministic project code.
They contain no third-party content, personal data, real credentials, provider captures, or media.

Use is currently limited to internal development and testing of this private repository.
Public redistribution terms have not been selected and remain UNVERIFIED. This notice must be
revisited before the fixture set is published, relicensed, or moved to a shared public corpus.
